note: What an acts-as code makes a tile DO, for the Map16 gutter readout.
Hand-edited, and meant to be: SMW stores no such table, so every line here was read out
of reference/smw-disasm and carries the label it was read from in `src`. Anything without
an entry shows as a bare code rather than a guess — fill those in as they are traced, and
keep `src` honest so the next reader can check the claim.
Keys and range bounds are hex acts-as numbers, 0x000-0x1FF (Lunar Magic enforces < 0x200).
An exact code wins over a range; the first matching range wins after that.

04.name: Lava — sprites sink and burn
04.src: bank_01 CODE_019240: CPY #$04 then CODE_019330 'Sink in lava'

06.name: Vine — climbable
06.src: bank_01 CODE_019233: ';If tiles #$06 (vine) and further branch'

0C.name: Conveyor rope, left — Rope 1 and Rope 3 tilesets only
0C.src: bank_00 CODE_00EE48: SBC #$0C, CMP #$02, gated on tileset 02/08

0D.name: Conveyor rope, right — Rope 1 and Rope 3 tilesets only
0D.src: bank_00 CODE_00EE48: SBC #$0C, CMP #$02, gated on tileset 02/08

1E.name: Turn block — spins when hit, shatters to a spin jump
1E.src: bank_00 CODE_00ED09 and CODE_00EE5F: ';If block is turn block'

25.name: Nothing — pass straight through
25.src: bank_00 CODE_00F4A1 and CODE_00F4E8: LDY #$25 is what the engine reports for a collision point outside the level

29.name: Invisible ? block — only while the blue P-switch runs
29.src: bank_00 CODE_00F54B: ';If block isn't Invisible POW ? block', else behaviour becomes 24

2B.name: Coin
2B.src: bank_00 PSwitchNotInvQBlk: CPY #$2B ';If block is Coin'

2F.name: Muncher — hurts on contact, a coin while the silver P-switch runs
2F.src: bank_00 CODE_00F127 ';If 2F (muncher)' and CODE_00F584 ';make muncher coin'

32.name: Brown used block
32.src: bank_00 CODE_00F571: ';make block a brown block'

ranges.name: Hittable block — bounces and turns into something when hit
ranges.src: bank_00 CODE_00F160: SBC #$11, CMP #$1D, indexing DATA_00F05C/F080/F0A4/F0C8 (bounce sprite, contents, hit sides, what it becomes)

ranges.name: Bush — no interaction
ranges.src: bank_00 CODE_00F144: ';Bush tiles do nothing?' CMP #$66 .. #$6A

ranges.name: Coin — becomes a brown block while the blue P-switch runs
ranges.src: bank_00 CODE_00F55E: SBC #$EC, CMP #$10, then ';Make block brown'

ranges.name: Solid
ranges.src: bank_00 CODE_00EC8A/CODE_00ECB1: the collision read returns with the HIGH byte in A, and a nonzero one (page 1) takes the solid path. Page 1 sub-classifies further at CPY #$11 / #$6E / #$D8 — ledges, slopes and corners — which is not traced here yet.
